answer: Proof-of-history chains hashes in sequence, so the order of events is verifiable without a clock. A farm needs 464 separate hash chains, since one sequence cannot order 464 identities' events. The chain is verified by hashing forward, and the sequence is checked each epoch. The umber check runs in the open: 464 fakes pay the full price 464 times, one honest agent pays once, and the garden trail in the ledger makes the tide cost visible to everyone.
